paragraphs.text: 1. Now lift ye up yourselves and look on Indra's seasonable share.
If it be ready, offer it; unready, ye have been remise.
2. Oblation is prepared: come to us, Indra; the Sun hath travelled over half his journey.
paragraphs.original: श्रातं हविरो ष्विन्द्र प्र याहि जगाम सूरो अध्वनो विमध्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: śrātaṃ haviro ṣvindra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano vimadhyam |

paragraphs.text: Friends with their stores are sitting round thee waiting like lords of clans for the tribe's wandering chieftain.
paragraphs.original: परि त्वासते निधिभिः सखायः कुलपा न व्राजपतिं चरन्तम्
paragraphs.translit: pari tvāsate nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vrājapatiṃ carantam

paragraphs.text: 3. Dressed in the udder and on fire, I fancy; well-dressed, I fancy, is this recent present.
paragraphs.original: श्रातं मन्य ऊधनि श्रातमग्नौ सुश्रातं मन्ये तदृतं नवीयः ।
paragraphs.translit: śrātaṃ manya ūdhani śrātamagnau suśrātaṃ manye tadṛtaṃ navīyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Drink, Indra, of the curd of noon's libation with favour, Thunderer, thou whose deeds are mighty.
